criteria.no_way_around: A cheaper way exists and was measured. within_reach_of tests all four corners with hypot for every offered privy seat (149,854 calls at 40 hh seed 47), but only the corner farthest on both axes can fail. One squared comparison on that corner gives the identical outcome on all 16 rolls (same placer calls, same refusal, web within 0.03 s) and cuts homesteads 6.03 -> 5.86 s at 40 hh seed 47 and 1.31 -> 1.24 s at 15 hh. For the web's share, a seating that keeps 0042 and 0047 without leaving knotted or stranded ways has not been tried (d7586617f's KNOTTED_TRIES did this for Kuwabata alone); until it is, the repair cost is not shown unavoidable.
